top_signals.title: US Stocks End Day Lower as AI-Driven Swings Whipsaw Investors
top_signals.summary: US stocks finished lower, capping a day of whiplash that saw the Nasdaq 100 Index briefly enter bear-market territory before retracing most of its losses, as dip buyers looked past the biggest concerns clouding the outlook for artificial intelligence.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
